mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email_id, password, mobile_number, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by, display_name, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{emailId}, #{password}, #{mobileNumber}, #{createdOn, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, #{createdBy}, #{modifiedOn, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler}, #{modifiedBy}, #{displayName}, 'N' );
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName}, email_id = #{emailId}, mobile_number = #{mobileNumber}, modified_at = #{modifiedOn}, modified_by = #{modifiedBy} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, modified_at = #{modifiedOn}, modified_by = #{modifiedBy} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.delete: UPDATE users SET is_deleted = 'Y' display_name = 'deleted_user', email_id = null, mobile_number = null, modified_at = #{modifiedOn}, modified_by = #{modifiedBy} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT user_id AS userId, email_id as emailId, mobile_number as mobileNumber, display_name as displayName FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
